name: annotation-mode
description: Annotate standalone HTML prototypes and turn approved URL or image references into locally runnable prototypes.

interface.shortDescription: Annotate and build reviewable HTML prototypes.
interface.longDescription: Adds a floating controller, gated annotation mode, stable visible-element anchors, localStorage persistence, CRUD actions, responsive marker placement, URL-to-code cloning, and image-to-code prototype workflows.
interface.defaultPrompt: Add or review floating annotation mode in this HTML prototype. You can also use URL To Code or Image To Code for a referenced design.
